name: Corporate Grunge
summary: As grunge began to take hold in the mainstream, companies were quick to mass market the aesthetics and motifs often used within the grunge genre, such as working class fashion heavily rooted in Seattle, distressed typeface, collage imagery and industrial decay.
description: As grunge began to take hold in the mainstream, companies were quick to mass market the aesthetics and motifs often used within the grunge genre, such as working class fashion heavily rooted in Seattle, distressed typeface, collage imagery and industrial decay. The authenticity of the genre was stripped to market the young demographic within Generation X.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Controlled rebellion, dilution, anti-consumerist aesthetic
